notes.title: New version 2.3.2 - SteamOS, Big Picture & Controllers
notes.notes:
The new version of Voyage to Farland adds some features that are useful for Steam's Big Picture mode and SteamOS plus improvements to controller support for all OSes.

[list]
[*] Bundled Java for Linux and SteamOS
[*] Automatically opens in fullscreen when launched in Big Picture
[*] Full controller support
[*] Launch options for remapping controller buttons, setting volumes, etc.
[/list]

Head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/364790/discussions/0/490125737457849625/]Discussions[/url] for more info, or jump right in with the new mini-guide covering the new stuff:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=551861067]Voyage to Farland: Big Picture, Controllers, Linux & SteamOS[/url]
